evidence.inferred: lufs.to's per-track measurements (https://lufs.to/genres and the release pages its genre pages link; 2,544 distinct tracks across 27 genre pages; 'dynamic range' there is defined on https://lufs.to/methodology as peak minus RMS of the whole track, the same quantity MixMeter.crestDB computes) give crest = 5.28 - 0.743 x integrated LUFS (r = -0.88, residual SD 1.36 dB). Applied to this genre's integrated-loudness range -10.8 to -8.4 LUFS (this profile's own mix.lufs.integrated), typical -9.5 LUFS -> 12.3 dB.
